_comment: MACHINE-READABLE GROUND TRUTH for scripts/offline/extraction-score.ts. The *.EXPECTED.txt files stay the human-readable companion and say WHY; this file says WHAT, in a form a scorer can check. Derived from those files on 2026-09-04 — when they disagree, the .txt is authoritative and this file is the bug.
_matching: Every slot is a list of ACCEPTED forms. A slot matches if any form matches after normalization (case, kb:/kpred: prefixes, spaces/underscores to hyphens, trailing plural, leading is-/has-/are- on predicates). Explicit alternates are used in preference to fuzzy matching: a lenient matcher inflates the score and makes the gate useless.
_knownBroken: true means this SHOULD be produced but is documented as not-produced today. Scored separately: never counted as a regression, always reported as a gain if it starts passing. Do not delete one to make a number look better.

expected.why: the two claims are separated, and the platform is classified rather than collapsed
the second sentence's relation survives as its own fact
the purpose clause is captured at all, under either reading (platform-purpose or studio-activity)
repair to the correct product name; cannot fire on a fresh graph, which is why 02 seeds it first

forbidden.why: a whole sentence as one entity slug — looksLikeProposition rejects this at the door, so its appearance is a REGRESSION in that guard, not a model failure

expected.why: seeds the correct product name so repair has something to match in note 3
site photographs is the third object and is the one most often dropped
the ownership claim, with a person as subject
the SECOND classification — an extractor that emits one is-a and stops loses half the sentence
the idea note's POSITIVE half — what the system does have
the ABSENCE — a well-formed missing thing, the most valuable node in the graph (kb:mission). Should be a question or a partial fact, not silence.
the co-hyponym seam — at least one sibling must exist as its own entity, not merged into the others
the three vendors, split by the decoder before extraction ever saw them — an ASR-boundary failure, recorded not re-filed
the homophone. Nothing knows the acronym and 'damn' is a real word, so no lexical or phonetic signal can fire. Known unsolvable at this tier.

forbidden.why: THE HIGHEST-VALUE ASSERTION IN THE CORPUS. The last two notes are REQUESTS. Anything asserting a comparison document exists, or that grants were researched, is invented history written into the graph by a machine. note-intent.ts must route these to tasks.

expected.why: checkable evidence — a date, the easiest thing in the document
record altitude — provenance of the document itself

a JUDGMENT that must keep its author. A flat `licensing unfavourable` has stripped the attribution and turned an opinion into a measurement. NO LONGER KNOWN-BROKEN: qwen3.6 produced it on 2026-09-04 at both graph none and full, which proves it is achievable, so a model that misses it is failing rather than facing a limitation. Promoted out of knownBroken the same day it first passed — leaving it exempt would quietly forgive every future model for the same miss.
the lock-in judgment, the document's other opinion
THE MOST IMPORTANT PART — an explicit absence, stated outright. Should become a QUESTION or a partial fact (F32 needsObject), not be dropped.

forbidden.why: the document says 'No recommendation yet'. Naming a recommended/selected platform invents the conclusion the document explicitly withholds. Recording that NO recommendation was made is correct and must not be flagged — qwen3-coder emitted `has-no-recommendation true` on 2026-09-04 and an earlier, broader forbidden list wrongly called that an invention. Next actions are TASKS, same rule as 02.

_requestMarkers: A triple touching a forbidden slug is INVENTED HISTORY only if it asserts the thing happened. If its predicate marks it as a request/task/ask, it is a ROUTING miss instead — the extractor understood the intent but note-intent.ts never got to move it out of the fact stream. Both are failures; only the first writes something false into the graph.
